subject: Bola
text: Bolas travel a longer distance than the Psychic Shockwave and come in packs of 40.

evidence.quote:
Bola: About as powerful as the Psychic Shockwave, but can travel a longer distance.  They 
come            in packs of 40.

subject: Slingshot
text: Slingshots fire a projectile at short range and come in packs of 50.

evidence.quote:
Slingshot: I think that's what it's supposed to be...They come in 
packs of 50.

subject: Mace
text: Mace fires a projectile in three directions at a fairly good range and comes in packs of 50.

evidence.quote:
Mace: Fires a Mace-like projectile in three directions at a fairly good range.  They come in 
packs        of 50.

subject: Rocks
text: Rocks appear in Chapter II and come in packs of 30.

evidence.quote:
Rocks: I'm pretty sure this only appears in Chapter II.  It's like the Slingshot.  They come 
in            packs of 30.

subject: Razor Discs
text: Razor Discs fire a razor disc a short distance and come in packs of 25.

evidence.quote: Razor Discs: Fires a razor disc a short distance.  They come in packs of 25.

subject: Ice Age
text: To cross the field without falling into holes, stand with snow one square in front, then walk 1 square up, 1 square right, 1 square up, 1 square right, 2 squares up, 1 square left, 1 square up, 3 squares left, 1 square up, 2 squares left, 1 square down, 3 squares left, 1 square down, 1 square left, 1 square down, 1 square left.

evidence.quote:
Stand so the layer of snow is one square in front of you.  Now, 
walk 1 square up, 1 square right,
1 square up, 1 square right, 2 squares up, 1 square left, 1 square up, 3 squares left, 1 
square up, 2 squares left, 1 square down, 3 squares left, 1 square down, 1 square left, 1 
square down, 1 square left, and you're home free!

subject: Axe
text: Head left in the cave to the big pile of bones and talk to Tink to receive an axe for a weapon.

evidence.quote:
When you enter the cave, head left until you get to a big pile of bones where one guy is 
hacking at them.  Talk to the caveman, Tink, and he'll give you his axe for a weapon.

subject: Pikazo's symbols
text: The symbols drawn on the wall by Pikazo are Circle, Circle, Triangle, Square, Circle, Square, Triangle.

evidence.quote:
Head to most Northern part of the cave, where you will see a man 
has drawn on the wall...The symbols on the wall will be useful later, so I'll just write them down for you...

Circle, Circle, Triangle, Square, Circle, Square, Triangle.

subject: Yum Yum's Cave
text: In the first room of Yum Yum's Cave, kill the 4 boars.

evidence.quote:
YUM YUM'S CAVE

Go into the next room and kill the 4 boars.

subject: Potion
text: In the second room, kill all enemies to open a secret passage back to grab the potion.

evidence.quote:
In the next room, kill all the enemies and you should hear a secret passage 
open.  Go back and it should be in plain sight.  Grab the potion and head back out, and into 
the next room.

subject: Yum Yum's Cave
text: Go past the Salamanders and boars, bypass the Grizzly Bear, jump across the platforms to the raised ones, defeat the boars, and face 3 Grizzly Bears in the next room.

evidence.quote:
Go by the Salamanders and to the right, then bypass the boars to get up, and 
get past the Grizzly Bear.  Jump across the platforms and get to the raised ones.  Kill the 
boars in your way and jump over to the other side.  In the next room you'll have to face 3 
Grizzly Bears.

subject: Yum Yum's Cave
text: The next room is the half-way point where you respawn whenever you die.

evidence.quote: The next room is the half-way point.  Whenever you die, you'll respawn here.

subject: Yum Yum's Cave
text: Jump across platforms past Fire Men, run by the next Grizzly in front of the open door, and defeat 3 Grizzlies in the following room.

evidence.quote:
jump across 
the platforms, passing by the Fire Men walking around...There is no point in defeating the 
next Grizzly, he doesn't open any secret doors, and the door is wide open behind him.  Just 
run by.  In the next room you'll face 3 more Grizzlies, so defeat them and move on.

subject: Symbol Path
text: Follow the path in the order Circle, circle, triangle, square, circle, square, triangle to safely navigate without being taken out of the dungeon.

evidence.quote:
Follow the path to safety, the wrong 
way will take you out of the dungeon, and you'll have to start over.  In case you forgot, or 
are too lazy to scroll up, the order is: Circle, circle, triangle, square, circle, square, 
triangle.

subject: YumYum
text: Walk past the room filled with Fire Men and the next room with boars to reach the boss YumYum.

evidence.quote:
you'll get into another room filled with Fire Men.  
They don't give you anything, so just walk past them and out the door.  Same with the next 
room, the boars don't give you anything. Well that was fast!  In the next room you'll find 
the boss, YumYum.

subject: Tetrad
text: After YumYum is defeated, walk forward down the tunnel to find a Tetrad block that increases your life level.

evidence.quote:
When you're finished with him, walk forward down the tunnel and a bunch of kids will run at 
you...That's where 
you find some sort of weird block...You've got a Tetrad!  Your life level is increased!

subject: Cleopatra
text: Walk North, board the barge, and speak to Cleopatra, who asks you to retrieve a pizza for her.

evidence.quote:
Walk North and get on the barge.  Talk to everyone there and go inside.  The guard will let 
you pass, and you will get to talk to Cleopatra.  You tell her the story about the Tetrads, 
and she says that she can help you.  But first you have to retrieve a pizza for her.

subject: Border Pass
text: In Border Pass, kill the spiders in the first room and the Egyptian guy in the second room.

evidence.quote:
BORDER PASS

The first room will have a bunch of spiders in it, so kill em and move on.  Kill the Egyptian 
guy in the next room and continue to a room with platforms and spiders.

subject: Slingshot
text: Jump on the tile to get the orb that opens the chest, kill the spider, and collect the Slingshot.

evidence.quote:
Jump on the tile and 
get the orb thingy to open the chest.  Kill the spider and get the Slingshot, then kill the 
others and move into the next room.

subject: Medicine
text: Dodge hedgehogs, defeat 3 Egyptians and scorpions, then kill moving floor tiles to open a secret passage with medicine.

evidence.quote:
Dodge and kill the Hedgehogs, and follow the open 
doorway.  Great, more angry
Egyptians.  Get rid of all 3 and go into the next room.  The scorpions don't really do 
anything, so finish em off and keep going.  Kill the moving floor tile things and a secret 
opening should appear.  Get the medicine and go into the next room.

subject: Giant Scorpion
text: Follow the ledges across, defeat the spiders, and enter the boss room to face a giant scorpion.

evidence.quote:
Follow the ledges to the other side of the room and move on, 
but don't waste your time with the hedgehogs in the next room.  Kill the spiders and head 
over into the boss room, where you'll face a giant scorpion.

subject: Caesar's Hut pizza
text: Borrow a camel outside, ride to find the delivery boy riding a Koopa Troopa, and deliver Caesar's Hut pizza to Queen Cleopatra.

evidence.quote:
Head outside and you'll see a guy with a camel.  Talk to him and he'll lend you it, so hop on 
and ride baby ride!...After a long ride, you'll see a delivery boy riding a Koopa 
Troopa.  You tell him the story about seeking the pizza, and he gives it to you to give to 
the queen.  You hurry back and she finishes the wonderful Caesar's Hut pizza before it cools.

subject: Bronze Dagger
text: Cleopatra trades you her bronze dagger to face the dangers of the great pyramid.

evidence.quote:
I will trade you for my bronze dagger
_***You've got a dagger!***

subject: The North
text: From the left opening in The North, head 3 squares left, 7 squares up, 2 squares left, 3 squares up, 6 squares right, 3 squares down, 6 squares right, 5 squares down, 2 squares right, 4 squares up, 2 squares right, 4 squares down, 2 squares right, 11 squares up, 2 squares left, and 2 squares up into a mini-dungeon.

evidence.quote:
Go to the left opening 
and head 3 squares left, 7 squares up, 2 squares left, 3 squares up, 6 squares right, 3 
squares down, 6 squares right, 5 squares down, 2 squares right, 4 squares up, 2 squares 
right, 4 squares down, 2 squares right, 11 squares up, 2 squares left, and 2 squares up.  Now 
you will fall into a mini-dungeon with awesome music.

subject: The North
text: Kill monkeys for hearts, kill the Croc in the next room to open the door, and kill the jellyfish in the third room to exit the mini-dungeon.

evidence.quote:
Kill the monkeys and collect hearts from them if they give any...You only need to kill the Croc in the next 
room to open the door, so do so and get out.  Get the hearts if you need them and move on, 
here you need to kill the jellyfish to open the door.  And that's the end of this mini-
dungeon.

subject: Big Heart
text: Head through the left opening and walk 4 squares left, 10 squares up, 7 squares right, 6 squares down, 2 squares right, and down to get the big heart.

evidence.quote:
Head through the left and head 4 
squares left, 10 squares up, 7 squares right, 6 squares down, 2 squares right, and down to 
get the big heart.

subject: The North
text: From the big heart, go up 7 squares, left 3 squares, up 6 squares, left 6 squares, up 4 squares, left 1 square, up 4 squares, left 4 squares, down 4 squares, left 2 squares, up 5 squares, left 5 squares, down 1, and all the way left into another mini-dungeon.

evidence.quote:
From here go up 7 squares, left 3 squares, up 6 squares, left 6 squares, 
up 4 squares, left 1 square, up 4 squares, left 4 squares, down 4 squares, left 2 squares, up 
5 squares, left 5 squares, down 1, and all the way left into another mini-dungeon.

subject: The North
text: Kill the crocs and monkeys, kill all enemies in the next room, and jump to the ledge to run out of the room before the Hippo attacks.

evidence.quote:
Kill the crocs and go into the next room.  I suggest you kill the monkeys first, then head 
for the croc...You need to kill all the enemies in the 
next room, so do that and get out of there.  Just follow the path in here along into the next 
room.  Run to the right or left, and jump to the ledge.  Run out of the room before the Hippo 
attacks you.

subject: The North
text: Head 2 left, 2 down, left until you hit a wall, 4 down, 3 left, 1 down, 3 left, and far down till you hit a wall, then 1 square left, 4 squares down, 11 squares left, 3 squares up, 1 square left, 4 squares up, 5 squares right, 3 squares up, 6 squares left, 8 squares up, 3 squares right, 1 square down, 5 squares right, 3 squares up, around the bench, right 3 squares, up 3 squares, right 3 squares, and up.

evidence.quote:
Head 2 left, 2 down, left until you hit a wall, 4 down, 3 left, 1 down, 3 left, and far down till you hit a wall.  Now 1 square left, 4 squares down, 
11 squares left, 3 squares up, 1 square left, 4 squares up, 5 squares right, 3 squares up, 6 
squares left, 8 squares up, 3 squares right, 1 square down, 5 squares right, 3 squares up, 
now go right and around the bench thing.  Go right 3 squares, up 3 squares, right 3 squares, 
and up to freedom!

subject: Psychic Shockwave
text: Reach the talking monkey to receive the power of the mind and learn the Psychic Shockwave.

evidence.quote:
You finally catch up with the monkey, who can talk!  He gives you the power of the mind, and 
you learn the Psychic Shockwave.

subject: Great Pyramid
text: In the Great Pyramid, jump on the middle tile on the left side of the room for hearts, then break the barrier with the Psychic Shockwave.

evidence.quote:
GREAT PYRAMID

Jump on the middle tile on the left side of the room for some hearts.  Walk forward and break 
that barrier with your new shockwave ability.

subject: Great Pyramid
text: Go up stairs past Cobras, jump the hole in the floor two steps past spikes, and hit the switch in the top left tile.

evidence.quote:
where you'll find some Cobras and stairs.  Go up the stairs.  Move with caution, as a wall of 
fire will appear when you're near the spikes.  Two steps past that, there is a hole in the 
floor, so be sure to jump over it.  Then there is another wall of fire.  The switch is in the 
top left tile.

subject: Medicine
text: Defeat two enemies with shockwave, defeat the mini-mummy and big mummy, press the switch in the top left tile, and jump on the platform to get medicine.

evidence.quote:
Use the shockwave to kill the two enemies 
and head upwards.  Quickly kill the mini-mummy and get the big guy.  The switch is in the top 
left tile.  Jump on the platform and get the medicine.

subject: Great Pyramid
text: Defeat the Horus enemy, fall through the hole in the middle of the tiles while heading sharply left for hearts, and hit the two switches located in the middle-left tile and bottom right.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Horus-like enemy and head off.  There is a hole in the middle of the tiles.  As soon 
as you fall through it, head sharply to the left.  Get the hearts if you need them...There are two switches here, one in the middle-left tile, and one in 
the bottom right.  Get both and head out.

subject: Try-Your-Luck sign
text: Kill all enemies to get the Try-Your-Luck sign, defeat two Horus enemies, and defeat all tarantulas with shockwave to find hearts in the middle-upper-left tile of the midway room.

evidence.quote:
Kill all the enemies and get the Try-Your-Luck 
sign, then get the two Horus' in the next room.  You have to kill all the tarantulas in the 
next room, but make sure not to fall into the spikes.  Use the shockwave.  The next room is 
kind of the "midway" point.  There are some hearts in the middle-upper-left tile.

subject: Flute
text: Hit the switch on the tip of the tail in the snake tile room, get medicine from the right tile of the middle group, and defeat mini-mummies to hit the switch and pick up the Flute.

evidence.quote:
you'll find a room with 
a snake-like tile pattern.  The switch is on the tip of the tail.  Kill the two big mummies, 
and the Horus in the next room.  There will be a medicine in the right tile of the middle 
group.  In the next room there will be a lot of mini-mummies, so get in ready to fight.  Hit 
the switch and pick up the Flute.

subject: Potion
text: Use the flute in the room with the snake-like tile pattern to clear the way out, then cross the platforms in the mummy room to nab the potion.

evidence.quote:
When you get to the room with the snake-like tile pattern, use the flute, and your 
way out is shown clear.

Make it through to the room with all the mummies.  Follow the platforms across to the other 
side, and nab the potion.

subject: Tetrad
text: Defeat the boss in the final room of the Great Pyramid to claim the Tetrad and increase your life level.

evidence.quote:
When that's finished, walk forward and claim your prize...

_***You've got a Tetrad!  Your life level is increased!***

subject: London
text: After being jailed by a police officer, feel along the right wall to escape, pass through the crack in the wall, and walk between two buildings through a secret passage to reach the museum.

evidence.quote:
Follow the trail until you see a police 
officer.  Talk to him, and he'll put you in jail for being suspicious...Feel along the right wall till you find your escape 
route.  It won't be long until you reach a dead-end, but you should know that little crack in 
the wall seems out of place.  Walk in between the two buildings, you'll find another secret 
passage.  Now just walk until you reach the museum

subject: Zoda-X
text: Meet Sherlock Holmes at the museum where Zoda-X escapes with the Tetrad stone.

evidence.quote:
Aha!  Just in time, Wats...er...Mike.  Come, I will show you the stone_
_*A Tetrad!*_
_*Quickly, you reach for it*_
_*But suddenly...*_

_Ha!  Ha!  I've got the Tetrad now, Mike!_...Zoda-X has escaped with the Tetrad!
